TETRA_N192.npz.method: retained linear tetrahedron N=192; angular-frequency 1.2, reference bare lattice

surface: ../REFERENCE_KERNEL.npz and ../REFERENCE_KERNEL.json, retained N=192 surface grid, PV order 256
mass_controls: m_q/m_b=0.75, 1, 1.25 were chosen before evaluating the additional line-mass test, holding Kq, bulk, taper, and drive frequency fixed. The first and third points are distinct from the original one-factor speed scan, which varied Kq at fixed masses. The nominal entry repeats the reference.
normalization: For angle kappa a satisfying 2 Kq[1−cos(kappa a)]=m_q omega^2, gamma=2 Kq sin(kappa a). With incident displacement 1, incident power is omega gamma/4. The 19-coordinate solve divides the bulk work omega f†Q_C f/2 by this value. The 7-coordinate calculation mass-normalizes both the line dynamical matrix and lead widths and eliminates the corners. Both compare to the exact propagating-lead limit on the respective stored kernel.
scope: No bulk integrals were regenerated. The two retained grids do not enclose the exact-lattice error; the values describe sampled harmonic-model configurations at the specified frequency.
